Say to your AI: "Get my question classifier model ready to run on my Mac", and give it model (The model's value, read from your list: `classifier` names the family (questions-first-decider) and `weights` says where its weights are ({"folder": a folder on this Mac} or {"hugging_face": {"repo", "revision"}} with a pinned revision).).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:get-a-classifier-ready-on-this-mac and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: {"result": {"classifier", "identity", "files": [{"name", "bytes", "blake3"}], "ready"}} or {"error": "what to change"}.
4. It reads and writes nothing in your records; its answer is the whole result.
